question: Is the Strait of Hormuz open, yes or no?

lines.text: The US military says it helped Gulf states export one and a half billion barrels of oil through Hormuz.
It says over three thousand ships crossed with its support in six months.
And it says over ninety five percent crossed safely.
Its commander, Admiral Brad Cooper, flew over the strait on Sunday.
He says the main lanes are clear of Iranian sea mines.

scene.quote: primary transit routes ... remain free and clear of Iranian sea mines

lines.text: Iran's Revolutionary Guards answered on X.
Spokesman Hossein Mohebi told Cooper: This is the reality on the ground.

scene.quote: This is the reality on the ground.

lines.text: AFP says Iran demands that ships get its permission to cross.
Tehran has set seven conditions to reopen it, including an end to the US blockade.
Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf says Washington must meet them before the strait reopens.
But the Washington Institute says October has seen the most ship attacks on record.
It counted twenty eight by the twenty third.
Washington says the oil is flowing. Iran says it still holds the strait.
Day two hundred and forty two tomorrow. Is the Strait of Hormuz open, yes or no?
